d:
Official Vidya Vox 2016 cover of "Cheap Thrills" by Sia.
Get this track on:
I've gotten SO many requests for this song - so here is our take on it! Thank you guys for your support, you are the best! Musically, we wanted to try something a bit different than my usual mashups! We got really silly in this one and had so much fun! Thanks to Shankar Tucker for the music production & Akshaya Tucker for killing it on the electric cello! Some of the vocal reverb are also from the TC Helicon Pedal, in case your wondering: Hope you guys enjoy this one! As always, more mashups coming your way!
